people.name: Thomas
people.line: One of Jesus' twelve disciples, known for doubting

translations.web: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”
translations.bsb: “Lord,” said Thomas, “we do not know where You are going, so how can we know the way?”
translations.kjv: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?
translations.asv: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; how know we the way?
